note: Copy this to config/local/comfy-bootstrap.json and edit it. config/local/ is
gitignored, so what you install stays yours. comfy/setup.ps1 prefers that
file over the manifest shipped in comfy/, and -Manifest overrides both.
revision must be the full 40-character commit id, in lower case. Read one
with: git ls-remote <repository> <tag-or-branch>
A tag is not accepted in this field: the owner of a repository can move a
tag to another commit, and then this file quietly stops describing the
installation it was written for. Put the tag in revisionLabel instead --
it is recorded for you to read and is never checked out.
The comfyui entry below is the real pin shipped in comfy/manifest.json,
repeated so this file works as it stands. Everything in customNodes and
models is INVENTED: the repositories do not exist, the URLs do not resolve,
and the hashes are made up. They are here to show the shape of an entry,
not to be installed. Replace them, or delete them. setup.ps1 refuses a
manifest it cannot resolve rather than falling back to a default branch.
PROFILES. The three are minimal, recommended and video, and there is no
full and no everything. -Profile picks one; entries say which they belong
to.
* a customNodes entry with no profiles list belongs to every profile, so
a manifest written before profiles existed goes on meaning what it did;
* a models entry MUST list its profiles, because the cost of the two
defaults is not the same: a node pack arriving is a directory, a model
arriving is tens of gigabytes;
* a models entry may NOT claim the minimal profile. Minimal is the
runtime and nothing else, and that is enforced when this file is read.
nodeClasses names the node classes a pack registers, spelled EXACTLY as
ComfyUI spells them. setup.ps1 prints them at the end of a run as the
-RequireNodeClass arguments for comfy/doctor.ps1, which looks each one up
in the live /object_info with a case-sensitive comparison -- because
ComfyUI's registry is case-sensitive, and a class_type that differs by one
letter's case is one ComfyUI will reject.
A MODELS ENTRY CARRIES ITS OWN VERIFICATION OR SAYS IT HAS NONE. Exactly
one of these two, and a manifest with neither is refused:
"sha256": "<64 hex characters>"   the download is checked as it arrives
"verification": "none"            you are saying out loud that it is not
A URL without a hash is a URL whose contents can change, which is the same
reason revision may not be a tag. An unverified download is announced as
UNVERIFIED in the plan and again when it lands -- silence is refused,
because a reader cannot tell it apart from an oversight.
file is a relative path under the models root, with forward slashes. It
cannot leave that directory. sizeBytes is for the plan you are shown before
you agree; with a sha256 it may be approximate, because the hash is the
check. With "verification": "none" it is REQUIRED and EXACT, and the
download is refused if the byte count differs -- it is the only thing such
an entry pins about its bytes. license is required. gated: true means
somebody has to accept a licence first -- LocalCanvas will never do that for
you, so a gated entry stops the run, prints gatedInstructions and downloads
nothing at all. requiresToken: true means the host needs a credential; it is
read from the HF_TOKEN environment variable at the moment of the request and
is never written to a file, a log line or a command line.
NOTHING HERE DOWNLOADS WITHOUT -InstallModels, and nothing downloads under
-InstallModels until you have been shown the whole list and said yes.

customNodes.name: example-node-pack
customNodes.revisionLabel: replace this entry with a node pack your workflow needs

models.name: example image model (invented -- replace it)
models.license: replace this with the licence the file is published under

models.name: example upscale model with no published hash (invented -- replace it)
models.license: replace this with the licence the file is published under

models.name: example video model behind a licence (invented -- replace it)
models.license: replace this with the licence the file is published under
models.gatedInstructions: open the licence URL above, accept the terms with the account you will use, then run this again
